title: Unearthing the Reality of "Zombie Energy Systems" in Africa's Energy Transition
summary: This Clean Air Task Force article examines 'zombie energy systems' in Africa—outdated fossil fuel infrastructure that continues to operate despite the urgent need for clean energy transition. The piece explores how these legacy systems create barriers to decarbonization and sustainable development across African nations.
problem_solved: Exposes how obsolete fossil fuel infrastructure in Africa inhibits the region's ability to transition to clean, sustainable energy systems.
why_valuable: Provides critical analysis of a systemic barrier to Africa's energy transition, helping policymakers and stakeholders understand why simply building new renewable capacity isn't enough without addressing existing fossil fuel dependencies.
